fixes.cause: Guest API intentionally returns an empty email and participant membership role. Android used registered-account validation and required the legacy guest role.
fixes.change: Guest-specific validation permits no email while retaining validated conference/user IDs and rejecting privileged member roles; legacy guest format remains supported. Ordinary account email remains required.
fixes.verified: Unit fixtures for current/legacy responses and privileged-role rejection; real isolated guest join, comment and leave.

fixes.cause: Removed transcript/summary actions were shown regardless of capabilities and old summary notifications could trigger removed routes.
fixes.change: Pass capabilities into recording state, hide retired material controls and guard all retired requests, including notification entry.
fixes.verified: ViewModel regression test, legacy UI tests and current no-speech UI test.

fixes.cause: GET /api/v1/recordings was no longer registered despite existing service and regression test; both live accounts received 404.
fixes.change: Restore authenticated route, keep guest scope enforcement and add private/no-store + nosniff headers.
fixes.verified: Existing backend test failed before fix, backend HTTP/usecase tests pass after fix, actual isolated catalogue includes active and finished meeting recordings.
fixes.deployment: VERIFIED LIVE on chat.stage.org.ru; see deploymentFollowUp.

checks.liveKnownFailures: Two 404 responses from the missing catalogue route; same cause on two accounts.

safety: Live server checks used reads and short-lived authentication/events connections only. Mutations, messages, uploads, account deletion and call state changes ran only on marked private localhost fixtures. No VPS/Amnezia/VPN changes.
limits: No physical Android device or acoustic/Bluetooth tests.
Actual Pion/SFU media transport and encoded recording processing were not exercised by this API fixture; call state and recording control metadata were verified.
Live accounts have sparse data; NO_SAMPLE entries identify unavailable live resources. Isolated fixtures supplied mutations and richer data.
Local fixture has actual current Go services, PostgreSQL, Redis and S3 but no recording worker; recordings remain control-plane metadata.

additionalFindingOutsideHttpApiAudit.finding: Hard-coded worker/live-worker service names remain, while current backend uses record-worker.
additionalFindingOutsideHttpApiAudit.status: Not changed; installer/container migration and signed-bundle publication are outside the HTTP/WebSocket API verification.

reproduce.assembly: fixture/fixture.py + main.go + explicit backend-fix.patch; no production business handlers mocked
reproduce.tests: MEETSPACE_CURRENT_API_FIXTURE points to the marked fixture home. MEETSPACE_STAGE07_LIVE=1 and MEETSPACE_STAGE07_FIXTURE point to its live.properties. Execute CurrentApiMutationTest and LiveMessagingRepositoryTest. LiveApiCompatibilityTest supports explicit origin/credentials and a fixture CA restricted to localhost.

result: Compatibility fixes remain in local Android source; backend recording catalogue is now verified live on chat.stage.org.ru. See deploymentFollowUp for current deployment status.

deploymentFollowUp.result: Recording catalogue now responds 200 on chat.stage.org.ru and passes Android repository validation on two accounts.
